---
title: "Validation and stopping"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cli)

algeria <- read_csv("data/Algeria.csv") |>
  mutate(
    lifeExp_cat = cut(lifeExp, quantile(lifeExp, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE),
    pop_cat = cut(pop, quantile(pop, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1), na.rm = TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE),
    gdpPercap_cat = cut(gdpPercap, quantile(gdpPercap, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )
```

## `plot_top_n_lifexp()`

```{r}
#| label: plot-function
plot_top_n_lifexp <- function(.df, n = 5) {
 .df |>
    slice_max(lifeExp, n = n) |>
    mutate(
      country_year = paste(country, year, sep = ": "),
      country_year = fct_reorder(country_year, lifeExp)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(lifeExp, country_year, group = 1)) +
    geom_point()
}

plot_top_n_lifexp(algeria)
plot_top_n_lifexp(algeria, n = 7)
```
